[USER] User asks for tips for staying healthy during cold and flu season.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips for staying healthy during cold and flu season include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Wash hands frequently with soap and water for at least 20 seconds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Practice good hygiene: cover mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, avoid touching face, and clean frequently touched surfaces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Get enough sleep: aim for 7-8 hours of sleep each night.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Stay hydrated: drink plenty of fluids like water, tea, and broth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Manage stress: practice relaxation techniques such as meditation or yoga.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Exercise regularly: be physically active for at least 30 minutes per day.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Consider getting vaccinated against certain strains of the flu virus.
